title: 第22章 霓虹尽头，沈曼沦陷

第22章 霓虹尽头，沈曼沦陷-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

沈蔓今天换了一条浅色的碎花连衣裙。

头发没有全扎起来，散了一半在肩膀上，耳垂上坠着两颗小小的珍珠耳钉。

妆化得比上次精致，但不浓。

唇色偏暖，衬得整个人干净又明亮。

抬头看到那辆银灰色的法拉利缓缓靠过来，她的眼睛亮了一下。

林川降下车窗，单手搭在窗框上，侧头看着她。

“等很久了？”

“刚下来。”

沈蔓快步走过来，拉开副驾的门坐进去，带进来一股清甜的香气。

不是上次那种淡淡的体香。

今天明显喷了香水，但选得克制，尾调是白茶和小苍兰，干净，不张扬。

林川扫了她一眼。

这姑娘今天是真用心打扮了。

连指甲都重新做过，浅粉色的法式甲，衬着她白到发光的手指。

“今天怎么穿成这样？”林川发动车子，语气随意。

沈蔓一愣：“怎么了？不好看吗？”

“好看。”

林川头也没回，嘴角勾了一下。

“就是准备得有点太认真了。怕我以为你对我有什么想法。”

“你——”

沈蔓的脸一下红了。

她嘴张了一下又合上，半天才挤出一句：

“我就是正常穿衣服，谁准备了，你少臭美。”

林川没再接话，但嘴角那个弧度一直没落下来。

法拉利汇入车流，沿着滨海大道往蛇口方向走。

车窗半开着，晚风灌进来，把沈蔓肩膀上散着的头发吹得微微扬起。

她偷偷转头看了林川一眼。

深蓝色休闲西装，白色T恤。

手腕上那块深蓝表盘的腕表，在路灯下一闪而过。

侧脸的线条被暮色勾出清晰轮廓，下颌角收得利落。

开车的姿态很松弛。

单手握方向盘，另一只手搭在中央扶手上。

沈蔓赶紧把视线收回来，装作在看窗外的风景。

“先不急着吃饭。”

林川在一个路口打了方向灯。

“带你逛逛。”

“逛什么？”

“你总不能每次见我都空着手回去。”

沈蔓愣了一下：“买什么东西啊，不用——”

“到了再说。”

车子最终停在了市中心一个高档商场的地下车库。

电梯门打开，冷气和灯光同时涌过来。

大理石地面擦得能照见人影。

两侧全是玻璃橱窗，暖黄色的射灯把里面陈列的包、鞋、珠宝照得流光溢彩。

沈蔓放慢了脚步。

她不是没来过这种地方。

空姐的收入不差，偶尔也会进来看看。

但大多数时候，也就是看看。

那些橱窗里的价签，她心里有数。

林川走在她旁边，步伐很自然，进得随意。

两人在一楼转了半圈，林川在一家店门口停下来。

“进去看看。”

沈蔓跟着他走进去。

灯光柔暖，空气里弥漫着皮革特有的高级气味。

几排陈列架上摆着当季的新款手袋，每一只都被单独打了光。

一个穿制服的女销售迎上来。

她的目光先在林川身上扫了一圈，又落到沈蔓身上，最后停在沈蔓那条碎花裙子的牌子上。

嘴角的弧度微妙地收了两分。

“两位看点什么？”

语气谈不上冷淡，但也绝对算不上热情。

这种客气里带着打量的态度，在这类店里并不少见。

旁边试包的一个女顾客瞥了一眼，又低下头继续照镜子。

林川没理会，目光已经落在角落陈列架上一只水蓝色的手袋上。

“那只拿下来看看。”

销售走过去，伸手的时候嘴里习惯性带了一句：“这款是今年早秋限定，全球限量的，价格比较——”

“拿过来就行。”

林川语气平和，但没给她把后半句说完的机会。

Chapter 22 At the end of neon, Shen Man falls - "Rebirth 2000: I broke the agreement and became rich"

Shen Man changed into a light-colored floral dress today.

Her hair was not tied up, half of it was hanging on her shoulders, and there were two small pearl earrings hanging on her earlobes.

The makeup is more refined than last time, but not too thick.

The lip color is warm, making the whole person clean and bright.

When she looked up and saw the silver-gray Ferrari slowly approaching, her eyes lit up.

Lin Chuan lowered the window, put one hand on the window frame, and looked sideways at her.

"Been waiting for a long time?"

"Just got down."

Shen Man walked over quickly, opened the passenger door and got in, bringing in a sweet aroma.

It's not the light body fragrance like last time.

I obviously wore perfume today, but I chose it with restraint. The base notes are white tea and freesia, which is clean and unobtrusive.

Lin Chuan glanced at her.

This girl really dressed up today.

Even her nails were redone, with light pink French nails that set off her gleaming white fingers.

"Why are you dressed like this today?" Lin Chuan started the car and spoke in a casual tone.

Shen Man was stunned: "What's wrong? Doesn't it look good?"

"Good looking."

Lin Chuan didn't even look back, and the corner of his mouth curled up.

"I just prepared a little too seriously. I'm afraid I'll think you have something in mind for me."

"You——"

Shen Man's face turned red.

She opened and closed her mouth, and it took her a long time to squeeze out a sentence:

"I'm just wearing my normal clothes. Who's prepared? Don't be so pretty."

Lin Chuan didn't answer any more, but the curve of the corner of his mouth never dropped.

The Ferrari merged into the traffic and walked along Binhai Avenue towards Shekou.

The car window was half open, and the evening breeze blew in, blowing the hair scattered on Shen Man's shoulders slightly.

She secretly turned her head and glanced at Lin Chuan.

Dark blue casual suit, white T-shirt.

The watch with a dark blue dial on his wrist flashed by under the streetlight.

The lines of the side face were clearly outlined by the dusk, and the angle of the mandible was sharply retracted.

The driving posture is very relaxed.

Hold the steering wheel with one hand and place the other hand on the center armrest.

Shen Man quickly looked away and pretended to be looking at the scenery outside the window.

"Don't be in a hurry to eat now."

Lin Chuan turned on the blinker at an intersection.

"Take you for a walk."

"What are you shopping for?"

"You can't just go back empty-handed every time you see me."

Shen Man was stunned for a moment: "What are you buying? No need -"

"Let's talk about it when we get there."

The car finally stopped in the underground garage of a high-end shopping mall in the city center.

The elevator door opened, and air-conditioning and light rushed in at the same time.

The marble floor was so polished that people could be seen.

There are glass showcases on both sides, and the warm yellow spotlights illuminate the bags, shoes, and jewelry displayed inside.

Shen Man slowed down.

It's not like she's never been to this kind of place.

The salary of flight attendants is not bad, and they come in occasionally.

But most of the time, it’s just about looking.

She knew the price tags in the windows.

Lin Chuan walked beside her, his steps were natural and he entered casually.

The two walked around half a circle on the first floor, and Lin Chuan stopped in front of a store.

"Go in and have a look."

Shen Man followed him in.

The light is soft and warm, and the air is filled with the unique high-end smell of leather.

Several rows of display shelves display the latest handbags of the season, each of which has been individually polished.

A saleswoman in uniform came forward.

Her eyes first glanced around Lin Chuan, then fell on Shen Man, and finally stopped on the brand of Shen Man's floral skirt.

The curvature of the corners of his mouth subtly narrowed by two points.

"What do you two want to watch?"

His tone couldn't be called cold, but it definitely wasn't enthusiastic either.

This kind of polite and appreciative attitude is not uncommon in this kind of store.

A female customer who was trying on a bag next to her glanced at it, then lowered her head and continued to look in the mirror.

Lin Chuan ignored it and his eyes fell on an aqua blue handbag on the display shelf in the corner.

"Take it off and take a look."

The salesperson walked over and said something habitually when he extended his hand: "This is a limited edition for early autumn this year. It is a global limited edition. The price is relatively——"

"Just bring it over."

Lin Chuan's tone was calm, but he didn't give her a chance to finish the second half of the sentence.
